bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior 31-December-2018 audited position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2019 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete, the filing shows only one 3-month column, 'Taka(YTD)'), as published in the bank's own unaudited quarterly 'Financial Statements for the Period ended 31 March 2019'. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'ICB Islamic Bank Limited' with no consolidated qualifier, consistent with this bank's established reporting_basis in sources.json). As a Shariah-based Islamic bank, reports 'Investments' rather than conventional 'Loans and Advances' and 'Profit paid on deposits' rather than 'Interest expense'. SOURCE-DOCUMENT QUIRK (not a data error): every page header in this PDF misprints the year as 'as at 31 March 2018' / 'for the period ended 31 March 2018' (a carried-over template typo from the prior year's filing) even though every actual data column, the comparative column (correctly '31-Dec-18'), the Selective Notes section ('as on March 31, 2019'), and the signature date (April 30, 2019) all confirm this is genuinely the quarter ended 31 March 2019. Fully re-derived and cross-checked against every internal subtotal (balance-sheet identity: total liabilities 22,534,595,382 + total equity -11,055,427,343 = 11,479,168,039 vs reported total assets 11,479,168,040, a 1-taka rounding difference; operating-income chain A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT; EPS = PAT / 664,702,300 ordinary shares = -0.1577, rounds to reported -0.16) -- every check ties out. Equity has been negative since at least FY2012 (see insights.json); ROE is not calculated at the quarterly-file level in this dataset (only in ratios_timeseries.json, where it is nulled whenever equity <= 0 per the project's negative-equity rule).
